_how: Hand audit by the axiomops agent of each Qwen 3.5 4B summary (Axiom Discovery template) against the script. Counts factual errors a human must fix before using the summary. 'owner' = wrong or vague owner on a next step or a role swapped between interviewer and prospect.

factual_errors: People: says the dispatchers 'rotate on-call each week' (the script says two technicians rotate on call)
owner_errors: Next steps: 'Interviewer' sends the 10 answering-service emails (the prospect sends them)
Next steps: 'Interviewer' schedules the Thursday meeting (the meeting was agreed jointly; Thursday at two is right)
People: labels the Operations Manager as 'Speaker (Interviewer)'; the Operations Manager is the prospect
Next steps: every owner is 'Speaker', so it can't tell who exports the work orders (prospect) from who brings the proposal (Axiom)
missed: Owner approval for repairs over $500 missing from the workflow and volumes
The pilot building (Magnolia) is not named

factual_errors: Next steps: export is 'sent to Operations Manager' (the prospect is the Operations Manager; it goes to Axiom)
owner_errors: Next steps: 'Speaker (Operations Manager)' presents the proposal (Axiom brings it)

factual_errors: Pains: a supplement 'delays work by another two years' (the script says three or four weeks; the transcript lost those words in an overlap and the model filled the gap)
Volumes: the after-hail figure (300 leads) is missing because the words were lost in an overlap
owner_errors: Next steps: 'Owner' writes the one-page plan (Axiom writes it)
missed: CompanyCam: transcribed as 'company can be a little bit more' during an overlap
Three or four inspections a day per estimator (lost in an overlap)

factual_errors: Tools: 'Angie's List' (the prospect said Angi; the model expanded the name)
Next steps: puts the two-week trial at 'next Tuesday at 10 AM' (Tuesday at ten is the follow-up meeting)
owner_errors: Next steps: '[Meeting Organizer]' writes the plan (vague; it's Axiom)

factual_errors: People: says one dispatcher rotates on call each week (the script says two technicians rotate on call)
Volumes: lists next-step items (10 emails, Thursday meeting) as volumes
owner_errors: Next steps: every owner is 'Meeting Partner', so it can't tell the prospect's action from Axiom's
